4. Identify reef–year pairs where both depths were sampled; for these matched pairs, compute paired differences in prod_density.
5. Perform a paired t‐test on matched shallow vs deep prod_density values; additionally, perform an unpaired Welch’s t‐test on all shallow vs deep observations.
6. Fit a linear mixed‐effects model: prod_density ~ depth + (1|id_reef) + (1|year), treating depth as a fixed effect and reef and year as random intercepts; extract the depth effect estimate, standard error, and p‐value.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import scipy.stats as stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Aggregate to reef–year–depth
tran = (df
    .groupby(['id_reef','year','depth','transect'], as_index=False)
    .agg(total_prod=('prod','sum'), area=('area','sum')))
grp = (tran
    .groupby(['id_reef','year','depth'], as_index=False)
    .agg(total_prod=('total_prod','sum'), total_area=('area','sum')))
gr = grp.copy()
gr['prod_density'] = gr['total_prod'] / gr['total_area']

# 3. Descriptive summaries by depth
summary = (gr.groupby('depth')['prod_density']
           .agg(mean='mean', std='std', median='median', n='count')
           .reset_index())
print("Descriptive statistics by depth:")
print(summary.round(4), "\n")

# 4. Paired samples: reef-year pairs with both depths
pivot = gr.pivot_table(index=['id_reef','year'], columns='depth', values='prod_density')
paired = pivot.dropna()[['Shallow','Deep']]
print(f"Matched reef-year pairs: {len(paired)} samples\n")

# 5. Paired t-test and unpaired Welch's t-test
t_paired = stats.ttest_rel(paired['Shallow'], paired['Deep'])
t_unpaired = stats.ttest_ind(gr.loc[gr.depth=='Shallow','prod_density'],
                             gr.loc[gr.depth=='Deep','prod_density'],
                             equal_var=False)
print("Paired t-test (Shallow vs Deep):")
print(f" t = {t_paired.statistic:.3f}, p = {t_paired.pvalue:.4f}\n")
print("Unpaired Welch's t-test:")
print(f" t = {t_unpaired.statistic:.3f}, df = {t_unpaired.df:.1f}, p = {t_unpaired.pvalue:.4f}\n")

# 6. Linear mixed-effects model
# Encode depth and year as needed
gr['depth_code'] = gr['depth'].map({'Shallow':0,'Deep':1})
gr['year_cat'] = gr['year'].astype('category')
# Random intercepts for reef and year
md = smf.mixedlm('prod_density ~ depth_code', gr,
                 groups=gr['id_reef'],
                 vc_formula={'year': '0 + C(year_cat)'})
mdf = md.fit(reml=False)
print("Mixed-effects model summary:")
print(mdf.summary().tables[1], "\n")
print("Random effects variance components:")
print(mdf.cov_re, "\n")
print("Year-level variance components:")
print(mdf.vcomp, "\n")

# 7. Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.boxplot(x='depth', y='prod_density', data=gr, palette='pastel')
sns.stripplot(x='depth', y='prod_density', data=gr,
              color='gray', size=3, jitter=True, alpha=0.5)
# Model-predicted means and 95% CI
params = mdf.params
se = mdf.bse
# Shallow (depth_code=0)
mu0 = params['Intercept']
ci0 = 1.96 * se['Intercept']
# Deep (depth_code=1)
mu1 = params['Intercept'] + params['depth_code']
ci1 = np.sqrt(se['Intercept']**2 + se['depth_code']**2) * 1.96
# Plot error bars
plt.errorbar([0,1], [mu0, mu1], yerr=[ci0, ci1], fmt='o', color='red',
             capsize=5, label='Model estimate ±95% CI')
plt.xlabel('Depth stratum')
plt.ylabel('Productivity density (prod per m²)')
plt.title('Productivity density by depth stratum')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 8. Model diagnostics
resid = mdf.resid
fitted = mdf.fittedvalues
plt.figure(figsize=(12,4))
plt.subplot(1,2,1)
sm.qqplot(resid, line='s', ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('QQ-plot of Residuals')
plt.subplot(1,2,2)
plt.scatter(fitted, resid, alpha=0.5)
plt.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Fitted values')
plt.ylabel('Residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Aggregate to transect level: total prod and transect area
tran = (df
        .groupby(['id_reef','year','depth','transect'], as_index=False)
        .agg(total_prod=('prod','sum'), transect_area=('area','max')))

# 3. Aggregate to reef-year-depth: sum prod and area
grp = (tran
       .groupby(['id_reef','year','depth'], as_index=False)
       .agg(total_prod=('total_prod','sum'), total_area=('transect_area','sum')))
# compute productivity density (prod per m2)
grp['prod_density'] = grp['total_prod'] / grp['total_area']

# 4. Convert depth strata to numeric
depth_map = {'Shallow': 5, 'Deep': 20}
grp['depth_m'] = grp['depth'].map(depth_map)
grp['depth_m2'] = grp['depth_m']**2

# 5. Fit linear and quadratic models
model_lin = smf.ols('prod_density ~ depth_m', data=grp).fit()
model_quad = smf.ols('prod_density ~ depth_m + depth_m2', data=grp).fit()

# 6. Model summaries
coef_lin = pd.DataFrame({
    'coef': model_lin.params,
    'std_err': model_lin.bse,
    't': model_lin.tvalues,
    'p>|t|': model_lin.pvalues
})
coef_quad = pd.DataFrame({
    'coef': model_quad.params,
    'std_err': model_quad.bse,
    't': model_quad.tvalues,
    'p>|t|': model_quad.pvalues
})
print("Linear model coefficients:")
print(coef_lin.round(4), "\n")
print("Quadratic model coefficients:")
print(coef_quad.round(4), "\n")

# 7. Model comparison
aic_lin, aic_quad = model_lin.aic, model_quad.aic
r2_lin, r2_quad = model_lin.rsquared, model_quad.rsquared
print(f"Linear model:  AIC = {aic_lin:.2f},  R^2 = {r2_lin:.3f}")
print(f"Quadratic model: AIC = {aic_quad:.2f},  R^2 = {r2_quad:.3f}")
print(f"ΔAIC (lin - quad) = {aic_lin - aic_quad:.2f}\n")

# ANOVA for nested models
df_anova = sm.stats.anova_lm(model_lin, model_quad)
print("ANOVA comparison:")
print(df_anova.round(4), "\n")

# 8. Plot observed and fitted curve
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
# jitter for visibility
x_j = grp['depth_m'] + np.random.normal(0, 0.5, size=len(grp))
plt.scatter(x_j, grp['prod_density'], alpha=0.4, label='Observed')
# prediction curve

df_pred = pd.DataFrame({
    'depth_m': depths,
    'depth_m2': depths**2
})
pred = model_quad.predict(df_pred)
plt.plot(depths, pred, 'r-', lw=2, label='Quadratic fit')

plt.xlabel('Depth (m)')
plt.ylabel('Productivity density (prod per m²)')
plt.title('Productivity density vs Depth')

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import scipy.stats as stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Aggregate to reef–year–depth
tran = (df
    .groupby(['id_reef','year','depth','transect'], as_index=False)
    .agg(total_prod=('prod','sum'), area=('area','sum')))
grp = (tran
    .groupby(['id_reef','year','depth'], as_index=False)
    .agg(total_prod=('total_prod','sum'), total_area=('area','sum')))
gr = grp.copy()
gr['prod_density'] = gr['total_prod'] / gr['total_area']

# 3. Descriptive summaries by depth
summary = (gr.groupby('depth')['prod_density']
           .agg(mean='mean', std='std', median='median', n='count')
           .reset_index())
print("Descriptive statistics by depth:")
print(summary.round(4), "\n")

# 4. Paired samples: reef-year pairs with both depths
pivot = gr.pivot_table(index=['id_reef','year'], columns='depth', values='prod_density')
paired = pivot.dropna()[['Shallow','Deep']]
print(f"Matched reef-year pairs: {len(paired)} samples\n")

# 5. Paired t-test and unpaired Welch's t-test
t_paired = stats.ttest_rel(paired['Shallow'], paired['Deep'])
t_unpaired = stats.ttest_ind(gr.loc[gr.depth=='Shallow','prod_density'],
                             gr.loc[gr.depth=='Deep','prod_density'],
                             equal_var=False)
print("Paired t-test (Shallow vs Deep):")
print(f" t = {t_paired.statistic:.3f}, p = {t_paired.pvalue:.4f}\n")
print("Unpaired Welch's t-test:")
print(f" t = {t_unpaired.statistic:.3f}, df = {t_unpaired.df:.1f}, p = {t_unpaired.pvalue:.4f}\n")

# 6. Linear mixed-effects model
# Encode depth and year as needed
gr['depth_code'] = gr['depth'].map({'Shallow':0,'Deep':1})
gr['year_cat'] = gr['year'].astype('category')
# Random intercepts for reef and year
md = smf.mixedlm('prod_density ~ depth_code', gr,
                 groups=gr['id_reef'],
                 vc_formula={'year': '0 + C(year_cat)'})
mdf = md.fit(reml=False)
print("Mixed-effects model summary:")
print(mdf.summary().tables[1], "\n")
print("Random effects variance components:")
print(mdf.cov_re, "\n")
print("Year-level variance components:")
print(mdf.vcomp, "\n")

# 7. Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.boxplot(x='depth', y='prod_density', data=gr, palette='pastel')
sns.stripplot(x='depth', y='prod_density', data=gr,
              color='gray', size=3, jitter=True, alpha=0.5)
# Model-predicted means and 95% CI
params = mdf.params
se = mdf.bse
# Shallow (depth_code=0)
mu0 = params['Intercept']
ci0 = 1.96 * se['Intercept']
# Deep (depth_code=1)
mu1 = params['Intercept'] + params['depth_code']
ci1 = np.sqrt(se['Intercept']**2 + se['depth_code']**2) * 1.96
# Plot error bars
plt.errorbar([0,1], [mu0, mu1], yerr=[ci0, ci1], fmt='o', color='red',
             capsize=5, label='Model estimate ±95% CI')
plt.xlabel('Depth stratum')
plt.ylabel('Productivity density (prod per m²)')
plt.title('Productivity density by depth stratum')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 8. Model diagnostics
resid = mdf.resid
fitted = mdf.fittedvalues
plt.figure(figsize=(12,4))
plt.subplot(1,2,1)
sm.qqplot(resid, line='s', ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('QQ-plot of Residuals')
plt.subplot(1,2,2)
plt.scatter(fitted, resid, alpha=0.5)
plt.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Fitted values')
plt.ylabel('Residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()"}
